quitar-fondo.title: Remove Photo Background
quitar-fondo.description: Erase the background from an image and get a transparent PNG, without uploading it anywhere.
quitar-fondo.cta: Need to remove photo backgrounds every day for your business? We'll build you a custom tool, integrated into your catalog.
quitar-fondo.seoTitle: Remove Photo Background Free, No Upload | SonhoLab
quitar-fondo.seoDescription: Remove the background from a photo and download a transparent PNG. Free, no watermark, no signup: the image is processed in your browser, never uploaded.
quitar-fondo.intro: Cutting out a person or a product by hand takes time and rarely comes out even. This tool uses an AI model that runs inside your browser: it finds the main subject, erases everything else, and hands back a PNG with a transparent background. The photo never leaves your device.
quitar-fondo.step1Text: Drag the photo into the box or click to pick it from your computer. It works with JPG, PNG and WEBP, and there is no limit on images.
quitar-fondo.step2Text: The model downloads the first time, then works inside your browser: it spots the main person or object and erases everything around it.
quitar-fondo.step3Text: Check the result and download the image with its transparent background. No watermark, no signup and no waiting in line behind other users.
quitar-fondo.useCase1: You're adding products to your online store and need every photo to sit on the same white or transparent background.
quitar-fondo.useCase2: You sell over WhatsApp and want the item to show up clean, without the kitchen table and the rest of the room behind it.
quitar-fondo.useCase3: You're putting together a slide deck or a resume and need your photo cut out so you can drop it on another background.
quitar-fondo.faq1q: Is it free, or is there a limit?
quitar-fondo.faq1a: It's free and there's no limit on images. We don't ask you to sign up, we don't add a watermark and there's no paid tier: the work happens on your own computer, so we have no server costs to pass on to you.
quitar-fondo.faq2q: What happens to my photos? Are they uploaded?
quitar-fondo.faq2a: They aren't. The image opens and is processed inside your browser, on your device, and it never travels to a server of ours or anyone else's. You can test it: disconnect from the internet once the page has loaded and the tool still works.
quitar-fondo.faq3q: Do I need to install any software?
quitar-fondo.faq3a: No. It runs in the browser you already have, on a computer or a phone. The first time around it downloads the AI model, a few megabytes; after that it stays saved and the cutout starts much faster.
quitar-fondo.faq4q: What format does the image download in?
quitar-fondo.faq4a: As a PNG, which is the format that keeps transparency, so you can place it over any color or image. If you need a white background, open the PNG in any editor and put a solid color underneath before saving.
quitar-fondo.faq5q: Does the cutout always come out well?
quitar-fondo.faq5a: Not always. With people and well-defined objects the result is usually clean, but loose hair, glass, smoke or a background the same color as the subject can leave rough edges. It's worth checking the image before you publish it.
